tips.text: Stack a Resource Booster and a Resource Drop Chance Booster for the bulk Salvage and Alloy Plate.
Run Gabii Survival on Ceres for the Drakgoon materials; it drops both Alloy Plate and Circuits.
Clear the 1,800 Kuva in one Kuva Flood, then build.
Expect only the bulk resources to take time; nothing about the Zarr is RNG.
